name: Columbus, third voyage
summary: Sailing further south, Columbus reaches Trinidad and the Gulf of Paria, where the flood of fresh water from the Orinoco tells him he has found 'a very great continent'. He goes on to Hispaniola, where a royal inquiry sends him home in chains.

stops.note: Six ships; three go straight to Hispaniola.
South to find the equator's lands.
Three hills on the horizon; he names the island for the Trinity.
The Orinoco's fresh water: 'I believe this is a very great continent which until today has been unknown.'
Arrested by Francisco de Bobadilla and shipped home in chains.

informs.note: Columbus at the Gulf of Paria; Ojeda and Vespucci
